<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Arts and culture
*[[Pope Francis]] announces the [[Vatican Apostolic Archives|Vatican's historical archives]] of [[Pope Pius XII]]'s pontificate (1939–1958) will be accessible to scholars next year, effective 2 March 2020. [https://www.vaticannews.va/en/pope/news/2019-03/pope-francis-vatican-secret-archives-pius-xii.html (Vatican News)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-47444293 (BBC News)]

;Disasters and accidents
*A helicopter crashes in [[Central Island|Central Island National Park]], [[Kenya]], killing four [[Americans|American]] tourists and their Kenyan pilot. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-47438361 (BBC News)]
*A 4.6 magnitude [[earthquake]] is felt in central [[Alberta]] just before 6 a.m. The epicentre was determined to be just south of [[Red Deer, Alberta|Red Deer]], and is believed to be the result of tectonic activity east of the [[Rocky Mountains]]. No structural damage or injuries are reported, and it is unlikely to cause aftershocks. [https://globalnews.ca/news/5018535/earthquake-central-alberta-sylvan-lake-red-deer/ (Global News)]

;Law and crime
*[[Germany]] says it will amend the [[German nationality law]] to strip [[Multiple citizenship|dual nationals]] of their citizenship who have fought for foreign militant groups, such as [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]]. [https://www.thelocal.de/20190304/germany-to-strip-dual-national-militia-fighters-of-citizenship (The Local)]
*[[Cuba–United States relations]]
**The Trump administration announces it will allow lawsuits by U.S. citizens against dozens of [[Cuba]]n companies and other entities concerning property confiscated by the Cuban government. A spokesperson says Cuba's support for [[Venezuela]]'s incumbent president, [[Nicolás Maduro]], was taken into consideration when the decision was made. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-cuba/us-allows-lawsuits-against-cuban-entities-but-shields-foreign-firms-for-now-idUSKCN1QL1KV (Reuters)] 
*[[Mueller special counsel investigation|United States Special Counsel investigation]]
**Newly confirmed [[United States Attorney General|Attorney General]] [[William Barr]] announces he will not [[Judicial disqualification|recuse]] himself from the special counsel's investigation, per the advice of the Justice Department's [[Office of Professional Responsibility|ethics officials]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump-russia-barr/u-s-attorney-general-will-not-recuse-himself-from-mueller-probe-idUSKCN1QM01S (Reuters)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 United States presidential election]], [[2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries]]
**Former [[Governor of Colorado|Colorado Governor]] [[John Hickenlooper]] announces he is running for the  [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic Party's]] nomination to be [[President of the United States]] in the 2020 presidential election. [https://www.cnbc.com/2019/03/04/former-colorado-gov-hickenlooper-enters-the-2020-presidential-race.html (CNBC)]
*[[First cabinet of Donald Trump|Cabinet of Donald Trump]]
**The [[United States Department of Justice]] announces that former acting Attorney General [[Matthew Whitaker]] has resigned from the Department, with his final day in the department having been March 2. He had remained in the Department as a senior counselor to the Associate Attorney General after his stint as acting Attorney General. [https://apnews.com/0d618b3641c542e98286845c821e28cb (AP)]
*[[Stormy Daniels–Donald Trump scandal]], [[Rupert Murdoch#Political activities in the United States|Rupert Murdoch's political activities in the United States]]
**''[[The New Yorker]]'' reports that [[Fox News]] owner [[Rupert Murdoch]] [[Catch and kill|prevented the release]] of a story about [[hush money]] which [[Donald Trump]] paid to [[Stormy Daniels]] before the [[2016 United States presidential election|2016 election]] because Murdoch wanted Trump to win the election. [https://www.newyorker.com/magazine/2019/03/11/the-making-of-the-fox-news-white-house (''The New Yorker'')]
*[[Canada|Canadian]] [[President of the Treasury Board|Treasury Board President]] [[Jane Philpott]] resigns having lost confidence in the government's handling of the [[SNC-Lavalin affair]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-47447976 (BBC News)]
*[[2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis]]
**[[National Assembly (Venezuela)|Venezuelan National Assembly]]-declared interim President [[Juan Guaidó]] defies [[President of Venezuela|Venezuelan President]] [[Nicolás Maduro]]'s threats and returns to [[Venezuela]] where he is received by tens of thousands of people in Caracas. [https://www.apnews.com/f60b33eaf80c462382f2077cafe8827f (Associated Press)]

;Science and technology
*[[USB#USB4|USB4]], [[Thunderbolt (interface)#Thunderbolt 3|Thunderbolt 3]], [[2019 in science]]
**[[Intel]] makes [[Thunderbolt (interface)#Thunderbolt 3|Thunderbolt 3]] [[Open standard|open]] and [[royalty-free]] and gives the specification to [[USB Implementers Forum]], while [[USB Promoter Group]] announces the [[USB#USB4|USB4]] specification that is based on [[Thunderbolt (interface)#Thunderbolt 3|Thunderbolt 3]]. USB4 supports 40 Gbps transfer rates and enables the use of multiple data and display protocols simultaneously. [https://newsroom.intel.com/news/intel-takes-steps-enable-thunderbolt-3-everywhere-releases-protocol/#gs.IxSiv18Q (Intel)] [https://usb.org/sites/default/files/2019-02/USB_PG_USB4_DevUpdate_Announcement_FINAL_20190226.pdf (USB Promoter Group)] [https://arstechnica.com/gadgets/2019/03/thunderbolt-3-becomes-usb4-as-intels-interconnect-goes-royalty-free/ (Ars Technica)]
*The [[World Wide Web Consortium]] announces that [[WebAuthn]], a [[Web standards|standard]] for password-free logins on the web, is now an official web standard. [https://venturebeat.com/2019/03/04/w3c-approves-webauthn-as-the-web-standard-for-password-free-logins/ (VentureBeat)]
